claim_boundary: A proposed extensible classification and measurement map. Categories and title hints are not mathematical verification or acceptance criteria; existing metrics, budgets, seeds and thresholds are preserved.

memory_lifecycle.label: 持续运行内存与资源回收

scale_generalization.label: 规模与工作负载适应性

exact_solved_coverage.label: 经独立验证的精确求解覆盖率

exact_penalized_runtime_sec.label: 精确求解惩罚平均耗时

fixed_budget_normalized_gap.label: 固定预算归一化目标差距

time_to_first_verified_solution_sec.label: 首次经验证可行解耗时
time_to_first_verified_solution_sec.evidence: Requires timestamped incumbent solutions and independent checking of those solutions.

time_to_target_sec.label: 达到预定质量目标的耗时
time_to_target_sec.evidence: Requires a target fixed before candidate outcomes and complete censored-run handling.

primal_integral.label: 原始解质量随时间的积分
primal_integral.evidence: Existing solver traces are not independently checked incumbent trajectories with a frozen missing-value convention.

dual_progress_integral.label: 经认证的界随时间的进展
dual_progress_integral.evidence: Requires valid bound evidence, trace coverage and a fixed treatment of missing bounds.

search_work.label: 搜索节点与迭代工作量
search_work.evidence: observations.nodes and observations.iterations; unit and algorithm changes can make counts incomparable.

peak_rss_ratio.label: 成对峰值 RSS 比值
peak_rss_ratio.evidence: resource_usage.by_instance_set.*.*.memory; matched measurement scope and complete-pair counts retained.

cpu_time_ratio.label: 成对 CPU 时间比值

retained_memory_series.label: 连续求解后保留内存序列
retained_memory_series.evidence: Requires one long-lived process, declared solve/update/reset sequence and allocator scope.

memory_growth_per_solve.label: 每次重复求解的内存增长
memory_growth_per_solve.evidence: Requires a declared estimator, warm-up convention, workload sequence and uncertainty protocol.

thread_scaling_curve.label: 线程数与质量时间表现曲线
thread_scaling_curve.evidence: Requires a fixed thread-count grid, comparable target/quality and per-condition raw outcomes.

parallel_efficiency.label: 达到同一目标的并行效率
parallel_efficiency.evidence: Requires comparable time-to-target, declared reference thread count and hardware resource accounting.

sequence_solve_time_sec.label: 模型更新序列总求解耗时
sequence_solve_time_sec.evidence: Requires equivalent cold/warm sequences with every intermediate model and solution independently checked.

update_overhead_sec.label: 求解器模型更新开销
update_overhead_sec.evidence: Requires a declared sequence and separate update/solve timing.

independent_violation.label: 原始模型约束与整数性违背量
independent_violation.evidence: Independent verifiers check feasibility with existing task tolerances; no universal residual distribution report exists.

numerical_failure_counts.label: 数值失败与状态不一致次数
numerical_failure_counts.evidence: Raw statuses and verification artifacts; needs a declared numerical stress grid and denominator.

boundary_pass_counts.label: 预先声明的边界测试通过计数

operational_failure_counts.label: 崩溃、OOM、输出错误与超时计数
operational_failure_counts.evidence: operational_reliability.by_budget; raw failures remain in observations.

seed_dispersion.label: 跨 seed 表现离散程度
seed_dispersion.evidence: nuisance_robustness; uses the existing heuristic or exact seed report definition.

representation_dispersion.label: 等价实例表示敏感性
representation_dispersion.evidence: Existing nuisance/representation reports require a configured equivalence experiment.

same_seed_replay_consistency.label: 同 seed 重复执行一致性
same_seed_replay_consistency.evidence: Requires repeated identical inputs and declared equality/tolerance and schedule conditions; distinct from cross-seed variance.

controlled_retention.label: 规模与结构变化下的改善保留

setup_time_sec.label: 求解器读取与初始化耗时
setup_time_sec.evidence: Separate solver-owned setup from solve and wrapper time; include affected stages in the measured scope.

setup_peak_memory.label: 求解器初始化峰值内存
setup_peak_memory.evidence: Requires stage-qualified measurement; solve-only RSS does not identify initialization savings.

sources.title: SCIP automated testing
sources.support: Official test output distinguishes solve time, nodes, feasible/optimal coverage, first/best-solution times and failures.

sources.title: Rounding and Propagation Heuristics for MIP
sources.support: Authors introduce primal integral to assess finding feasible solutions early in search.

sources.title: MiniZinc Challenge 2026 rules
sources.support: Separate complete, incomplete and area scoring; parallel entries have a distinct resource setting.

sources.title: SCIP reoptimization
sources.support: Reuses information across a declared sequence of modified models.

sources.title: SCIP concurrent solving
sources.support: Thread allocation is part of the solving configuration.

sources.title: Gurobi concurrent optimization
sources.support: Concurrent races can be nondeterministic; callbacks need not describe every concurrent strategy.

sources.title: SCIP numerically exact solving
sources.support: Exact arithmetic and proof checking are separate capabilities; certificate completion may be required.

sources.title: Dolan and More: performance profiles
sources.support: Distributional comparison can be applied to a chosen metric; it does not choose a universal score.

sources.title: NVIDIA cuOpt LP/QP features
sources.support: Warm starts and CPU/GPU concurrent methods require appropriate scenarios and resource accounting.

sources.title: HiGHS parallel redesign
sources.support: Author reports thread-dependent time and memory tradeoffs; these are claims requiring independent replication.

sources.title: HiGHS solver-state cleanup
sources.support: Repeated reuse and retained allocation motivate a long-lived-process scenario.

sources.title: HiGHS singleton-row numerical tolerances
sources.support: Original-model feasibility can differ from a tolerance check on a transformed row; this example is a correctness fix, not automatic optimization admission.

sources.title: PyVRP Solution constructor memory
sources.support: Bitset membership changes representation and memory usage.

sources.title: PyVRP compute_neighbours allocations
sources.support: Initialization allocations require a measured scope that includes the affected stage.

sources.title: PyVRP perturbation neighbours
sources.support: PR-reported effects vary across routing families; reported numbers are not PitBench measurements.

sources.title: cuOpt warmstart and model updates
sources.support: Mixed API/capability and solver-state changes illustrate the need to classify scope separately from benefit.

admission_notes: Multiple objective and mechanism labels may apply to one PR; count each historical PR once.
Select the primary objective and qualification protocol before qualification results; secondary diagnostics do not silently change the primary score.
Retain unknown classifications and unavailable measurements. Missing support is not regression or rejection.
Correctness-only, feature, parameter, wrapper and maintenance PRs are classified but do not automatically enter the existing solver-optimization task scope.
Search nodes, iterations, allocator counters and hardware counters need comparability evidence and do not alone establish end-to-end optimization success.
Do not derive a composite score or a resource, parallel, numerical or trajectory acceptance threshold from this catalog.
